premises.text: Centralized data centers waste energy and face rising demand and semiconductor cost pressure
Software pools idle everyday devices into a network for intensive compute workloads
premises.evidence_span: software that harnesses the collective strength of everyday devices to tackle intensive tasks like video encoding, generative AI, and 3D rendering

premises.text: Providers of devices receive most of the revenue, up to a monthly cap per device
premises.evidence_span: share 70% of the revenue, and we allow you to earn up to $150 per month for each device

premises.text: Customers obtain cheaper, faster computing than cloud alternatives
premises.evidence_span: cost-effective, speedy computing and accelerate their workflows up to 30 times relative to the cloud

premises.text: The network extends device life and cuts energy waste relative to traditional data centers
premises.evidence_span: breathing new life into older devices and reducing substantial energy wastage relative to traditional data centers

value.text: Sustainable, equitable, fast distributed computing for intensive workloads

notes: Green impact kept as primary-domain premise P5 rather than only secondary_value; singleton D3 retained because speaker frames green initiative as distinct from the compute economics. Worldwide-grid imagery treated as vision framing. Storj/beta/waitlist excluded as traction.
